description: This file defines the NativeMapContainerProvider class for managing Google Maps integration in an Ionic/Angular app, including map initialization, marker management, camera controls, and driver location updates.

classes.name: NativeMapContainerProvider
classes.description: Main class providing map functionalities such as loading map, controlling camera, adding markers, and updating driver locations.

methods.name: loadMap
methods.description: Initializes the map with default location and sets up map ready event.

methods.name: checkGps
methods.description: Creates a map instance and retrieves current location.

methods.name: PumpControls
methods.description: Sets up camera movement event listeners to handle UI updates and geocoding.

methods.name: AnimateToLoc
methods.description: Animates camera to a specific location, adds markers and circles, and starts location tracking.

methods.name: startChecking
methods.description: Continuously updates user location and moves the marker.

methods.name: RefreshMap
methods.description: Animates camera to a specified address using geocoding.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets camera to current location, re-adds driver markers, and restarts location tracking.

methods.name: setMarkers
methods.description: Adds driver markers to the map and updates their positions.

methods.name: getBoundsZoomLevel
methods.description: Calculates appropriate zoom level to fit bounds within map dimensions.

methods.name: latRad
methods.description: Converts latitude to radians for zoom calculations.

methods.name: zoom
methods.description: Calculates zoom level based on map size and bounds.
